t: Short pile sleeve offers a smooth finish on large surface areas such as plastered walls or as a final top coat. Synthetic mohair, designed for optumum finish on woodwork and trim. Microfibre mix gives excellent paint load and release with minimal splatter. Closed fibres give a smooth and even texture. Thermobonded fabric delivers minimal lint loss. Suitable for emulsion paint.
b: Closed Fibres for Smooth Even Texture
